algorithm.hintTable: Use each support card's literal published hint list once; do not expand alternate/version IDs into additional hint opportunities.
algorithm.hintValue: (expected course effect^valueExponent) * ((expected course effect / discounted skill point cost * 100)^efficiencyExponent)
algorithm.hintFrequency: Multiply hint-table score by (1 + Hint Frequency Up / 100)^hintFrequencyExponent.
algorithm.deckOverlap: Multiply contributions already covered by the selected main deck by deckCoveredMultiplier.
algorithm.events: For each support event, score each mutually-exclusive choice from exact GameTora event topology, keep the best choice, and add eventWeight times the summed event value.
algorithm.eventHints: Use the exact granted skill ID, granted hint level, course effect, and skill point cost.
